# Drone Craft

> Aerial art and digital media by Colin Dixon, based in Mallacoota, Victoria, Australia.

Website: https://dronecraft.au/
Portfolio: https://coota.au/
Contact: mailto:col@dixon.au
Phone: 0419 415 000
Book a conversation: https://calendly.com/colindixon

## Work
- Aerial photography of Mallacoota's coastline, lakes, beaches and changing weather.
- Cinematic drone video and visual storytelling.
- Interactive 360-degree panoramas and immersive landscape views.
- Drone platform: DJI Mavic 4 Pro.

## Films
- Films page: https://dronecraft.au/films
- Films are sold on a 32GB SanDisk dual USB-A/C stick (1080p MP4, plays on most TVs) at a guide price of $35, and on DVD (guide price on request).
- Prices are a guide only. There is no checkout; orders and enquiries go to mailto:col@dixon.au.
- Fine art prints: https://art.oze.au/
- Seed titles: Inlet Mouth Opening (21 July 2020), Foreshore Holiday Park (2 January 2023), Rain Drenched Mallacoota from the Wharf (30 November 2023), Thousands of Smiles (28 December 2023), Captain Stevenson's Point to Coull's Inlet (28 January 2024).

## Identity
Colin Dixon is an aerial artist and digital strategist based in Mallacoota, Victoria.
This website is a portfolio and film catalogue, not an online checkout.
See https://dronecraft.au/ and https://dronecraft.au/films for the authoritative site copy and current links.
